drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 72-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.63, creatinine 1.93-1.95, hemoglobin 14.2-14.3, platelets 219-226, sodium 141, wbc 7.6-7.9; vitals dbp 70-76, heart_rate 81-86, map 88-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 121-128, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.92-1.93, hemoglobin 14.2-14.3, platelets 219-230, sodium 140-141, wbc 7.3-7.6; vitals dbp 72-75, heart_rate 81-86, map 89-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 123-128, spo2 97-98, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 72-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
